description_en: Enables or disables the native replication feature of ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL
description_zh: 调用ModifyDBInstanceReplicationSwitch接口开启或关闭RDS原生复制模式
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-db-instance-replication-switch --db-instance-id rm-bp00000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --external-replication ON --resource-group-id rg-acfmy0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBInstanceReplicationSwitch

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26243.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the native replication feature. Valid values:

*   **ON**
*   **OFF**
parameters.help_zh:
开启或关闭原生复制模式，取值说明：
- **ON**：开启。
- **OFF**：关闭
parameters.name: external_replication

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. You can leave this parameter empty
parameters.name: resource_group_id
